intended_claim: Fixed relation-SAE reconstruction broadly improves cross-group neighbor tasks, within-type IFN readout, or fixed-readout label efficiency.
intended_question: Do fixed dataset-specific SAE reconstructions improve cross-group neighbor tasks, within-type IFN readout, or fixed-readout label efficiency?
executor_model: GPT-6-based Codex; exact model ID unavailable
reviewer_model_resolution: requested model; tool exposes canonical agent name but no independently resolved model ID
confidence_scope: High for the descriptive rejection under this fixed protocol; no claim of universal failure or statistical population-level proof.
integrity_tag: INTEGRITY: WARN — exploratory/proxy scope, not observed fabrication
what_results_support: Under the fixed 15NN endpoint, relation SAE has a small positive ctrl mean difference versus h, with only2/6 positive donors, and is lower than MSE SAE on ctrl. It declines on stim and PBMC mean Macro-F1.
Within every eligible dataset/type, mean embedding-only IFN R2 is lower than h, and every paired heldout group has lower R2 after within-group seed averaging.
Primary label-efficiency AULC is lower than h and MSE SAE on all three dataset-condition summaries.

At fixed Leiden resolution1, mean ARI and NMI are lower than h for ctrl,stim,PBMC. Kang label-conditioned silhouette increases, showing that this geometric metric does not imply improved label agreement.
Relative to MSE SAE, relation SAE lowers original-h teacher KL and slightly increases original-neighbor retention in all three summaries. This is proxy fidelity, not new biology.
what_results_dont_support: Better IFN biology, causal mechanism, independent biological validation, or irreversible information destruction.
End-to-end label-cost savings or universally poorer readout performance beyond fixed alpha10 Ridge.
PBMC donor generalization; independent ctrl/stim cohort replication.
Unified ctrl/stim state preservation, UMI noise robustness, unseen-cohort confirmation, or optimum lambda.
missing_evidence: Independent cohort or untouched donor confirmation after fixing a biological question.
An independent state target or perturbation/functional measurement for a biological preservation claim.
A prospective label-acquisition protocol if annotation cost is the objective.
Separate new predeclared experiments for unified-condition state preservation or UMI robustness; those are outside this completed phase.
suggested_claim_revision: 在历史 Kang 与 PBMC 缓存的固定评估中，关系 SAE 比 MSE SAE 更接近原始 h 的关系几何，但未带来一致的任务收益：少标签 AULC、类型内 IFN 固定读出及聚类标签一致性整体下降；ctrl 近邻分类仅有小幅且供体不一致的平均增益。
next_experiments_needed: No extra experiment is required to report this bounded negative result.
Retain original h as the reference; if continuing, predeclare one biological target and validate it on untouched groups before more loss/architecture search.
To diagnose IFN-readout decline, separately test a TRAIN/VALID-only tuned readout or residual readout with a new fixed evaluation plan; do not claim mechanism from current results.
routing_action: Do not advance broad improvement claim. Record bounded negative result; narrow or pivot the objective before any new predeclared experiment.
